title: All data is synthetic and the engine is not ISDA-licensed or certified
description: Market history, trades and counterparty data are simulated; the SIMM-style engine uses published parameter values but is not ISDA licensed, not certified by ISDA and not validated against ISDA's calculator, so no number here is a margin call or a compliance claim.
evidence: Data source recorded on every output: 'synthetic (no market data)'; history of 2088 business days (2018-10-01 to 2026-09-30), 20 trades.
recommendation: Treat outputs as a methodology demonstration; obtain the ISDA licence and the calculator test cases before any production use.

title: rolling250_max RED for hs_im_eu_1plus3
description: Backtest highest rolling 250-day exception count returned RED for model hs_im_eu_1plus3.
evidence: 1d: 12 exceptions in 250 observations (RED). Expected exceptions at 99% are 1% of observations. Shortfall multiplier (smallest k so that k x IM is Green) is 1.142.
recommendation: Recalibrate (longer stress share or a floor on the multiplier) and re-run the battery; report the shortfall multiplier to the model owner.

title: Single OIS-style curve per currency; no multi-curve or tenor basis
description: Each currency has one curve used for discounting and projection, so tenor-basis and OIS-versus-IBOR spreads, and the SIMM sub-curve correlation, are never exercised.
evidence: All IR delta rows carry the sub-curve label 'OIS'; the sub-curve correlation parameter phi = 0.981 is never used. The EUR/USD cross-currency basis is a single scalar (-18.0bp on 2026-07-10).
recommendation: Add projection curves per tenor and a basis curve; extend the CRIF with sub-curve labels.

title: No inflation or credit-risk-class exposure; RatesFX only
description: The engine supports the IR and FX risk classes only and rejects other CRIF risk types, so inflation, credit qualifying and non-qualifying, equity and commodity exposures cannot be margined.
evidence: Risk-class correlation IR-FX is 0.15 in 2.8+2512 and 0.10 in 2.8+2506; all other psi entries are unused. Inflation rows are parsed but have no pricing or sensitivity source.
recommendation: Extend the portfolio and the parameter extraction before using the engine for mixed-asset netting sets.

title: CVA uses a normal approximation of expected exposure for linear trades only
description: EE = mu Phi(mu/s) + s phi(mu/s) assumes a Gaussian netting-set value; swaptions and FX options are excluded from the CVA because their exposure is not Gaussian.
evidence: 7 of 20 trades are excluded from CVA; they carry 43.4% of the book's gross absolute PV on 2026-07-10.
recommendation: Replace with Monte Carlo exposure simulation including option trades, then back-test the xVA VaR on the full book.

title: Hypothetical P&L on a frozen portfolio
description: Losses are the revaluation of the same trades one and ten days later with constant times to maturity, so there are no cash flows, no ageing and no trading; this is hypothetical P&L net of cash flows, not actual P&L.
evidence: The 1-day champion series has 1327 observations from 2021-08-30 to 2026-09-29, all computed on the 20-trade book with constant times to maturity.
recommendation: Add an actual-P&L backtest and ageing of trades when real positions become available.

title: One SIMM version is used for the whole historical backtest
description: The SIMM-style series uses 2.8+2512 for every date although it first applies from COB 2026-07-10; earlier dates would have used earlier versions with different weights and thresholds.
evidence: 2029 of 2088 history days (97.2%) precede 2026-07-10; the 2506 versus 2512 impact on the scenario day is in the attribution outputs.
recommendation: Run the backtest with the version in force on each date or report the version-change impact separately.

title: EU consolidated amendments, 12 CFR 237.8, 12 CFR 349.8 and CFTC 23.154 were not checked
description: Regulatory requirements were read from Delegated Regulation 2016/2251 as published and 12 CFR 45.8; later EU amendments and the parallel US rules of other agencies were assumed equivalent and not fetched.
evidence: VERIFICATION_LOG rows 6 and 7: 12 CFR 237.8 and 349.8 assumed parallel, not fetched; CFTC 23.154 not fetched; EU consolidated amendments not checked.
recommendation: Fetch and compare the consolidated texts before quoting any requirement as current.

title: ISDA credit, equity and commodity parameter tables not covered
description: Only the RatesFX parameters were extracted and cross-checked; tables for the other product classes were not read.
evidence: VERIFICATION_LOG row 1 'Not verified' and correction 9: credit, equity and commodity tables not checked (out of scope).
recommendation: Extract and verify the remaining tables before extending the product scope.

title: overall AMBER for hs_im_eu_1plus3
description: Backtest worst of Kupiec POF, Christoffersen independence and Basel zone returned AMBER for model hs_im_eu_1plus3.
evidence: 1d: 18 exceptions in 1327 observations (AMBER). Expected exceptions at 99% are 1% of observations. Shortfall multiplier (smallest k so that k x IM is Green) is 1.142.
recommendation: Recalibrate (longer stress share or a floor on the multiplier) and re-run the battery; report the shortfall multiplier to the model owner.

title: overall AMBER for xva_var
description: Backtest worst of Kupiec POF, Christoffersen independence and Basel zone returned AMBER for model xva_var.
evidence: 10d_nonoverlap: 4 exceptions in 132 observations (AMBER). Expected exceptions at 99% are 1% of observations.
recommendation: Review the sensitivity set and the CS01 ladder, add second-order terms, and re-run the 10-day backtest.

title: FX vega IM depends on a non-standard CRIF column (SigmaMarket)
description: FX vega amounts in the CRIF are vega times the market implied vol. The engine needs the market vol (column SigmaMarket) to turn them back into vega before weighting with the SIMM vol; a counterparty that treats the amount as already weighted gets a different IM from an identical-looking CRIF.
evidence: Scenario D4 (implied vol instead of the SIMM vol) moves IM from USD 5,264,394 to USD 5,109,601, a gap of USD -154,793 with no CRIF amount differing.
recommendation: Document the FX vega convention in the exchange specification and add the vol column to the CRIF reconciliation.

title: Kupiec (1995) and Christoffersen (1998) verified only against secondary sources and numeric references
description: The original papers could not be retrieved; the formulas were cross-checked against Federal Reserve restatements and independent numeric references (closed forms, chi-square size simulation).
evidence: Retrieval attempts returned HTTP 404 and 403 (FRASER, Federal Reserve, journal); restatements read: FRBSF WP 99-06 and FEDS 2005-21.
recommendation: Obtain the originals through a library and confirm the statistics line by line.

title: IR vega correlation rests on the methodology text, not on ISDA's calculator
description: The methodology has no separate IR vega expiry correlation table; the engine applies the 12x12 tenor correlation with f = 1 as described in the text, which was not reconciled to ISDA's reference calculator.
evidence: VERIFICATION_LOG corrections 7 and 8: tenor matrix minimum eigenvalue 0.005015 in both versions, positive semidefinite; reading from text.
recommendation: Reconcile IR vega and curvature results to the ISDA calculator test portfolios when licensed.

title: Backtest windows overlap for the 10-day horizon
description: Consecutive 10-day windows share nine days, so exceptions cluster and the Kupiec and Christoffersen p-values are over-sized; BCBS 22 section II warns against comparing 10-day measures with overlapping outcomes. The log uses the non-overlapping design for severity.
evidence: Champion: 31 exceptions in 1318 overlapping 10-day windows (RED) versus 2 in 132 non-overlapping windows (PASS).
recommendation: Keep the non-overlapping design as the pass criterion and report overlapping results only as supporting evidence.

title: One-at-a-time attribution leaves a large interaction residual
description: Changing one driver at a time ignores interactions between drivers, so the pieces do not add up to the IM change; Shapley (exact) and the sequential bridge both add up to zero residual.
evidence: On the scenario day the total IM change is USD 4,040,470; one-at-a-time drivers miss USD 274,134 (6.8%); Shapley and bridge residuals are USD 0 and USD 0.
recommendation: Report Shapley as the headline attribution and the bridge as the narrative.

title: schedule_im converts notionals at fixed base FX levels unless a market rate is passed
description: The default FX argument of schedule_im is the synthetic base level of each pair, so a caller that omits fx_spot gets a schedule amount on stale rates.
evidence: Sample book on 2026-07-10: gross schedule IM USD 22,577,637 with default FX versus USD 22,482,029 with the market FX (-0.42%).
recommendation: Make fx_spot a required argument or default it to the valuation-date market.
